status: operators frozen before comparison execution; UTC/local-standard boundary intersection clarified after the first fail-closed alignment attempt; peak operator renamed from local-solar to fixed-local-standard after independent review found source-grid longitude corrections do not cancel
retained_longwave_role: diagnostic SIMIMPL28 temperature/cloud emissivity estimate; not an observation
era_radiation_operator: normalize checksum-bound ssrd [-4,0) J m-2 to zero; divide ssrd and strd once by 3600 to W m-2; label each de-accumulated preceding-hour interval by its start (valid_time minus one hour)
shortwave_plane_rule: ERA ssrd and retained daily climate rad are horizontal-plane fields and form the primary daily-magnitude lane; SIMIMPL hourly radiation is hillslope slope/aspect transformed and is retained only as a geometry-confounded chronology lane
daily_grouping: fixed local standard date; no daylight-saving shift; daily energy and peak metrics require all 24 paired hours
period_boundary_rule: compare the exact timestamp intersection after preceding-interval start labeling and UTC-to-fixed-local conversion; report excluded boundary hours
peak_hour_rule: fixed-local-standard daily argmax; first maximum; include complete days where both series have positive daily energy; signed circular ERA-minus-retained offset in [-12,12] integer hours; no local-solar claim
winter_event_rule: November through March local-standard days with retained comparator daily precipitation greater than zero
metrics: hourly mean signed error W m-2
daily energy mean signed error MJ m-2 day-1
daily energy MAE MJ m-2 day-1
daily peak signed circular offset hours
daily peak mean absolute circular offset hours
protected: precipitation bytes and calibrated multipliers are read-only; precipitation is used only to select frozen winter-event days
